name: voxa-videochat-app
description: Voxa - Production-quality Random Live Video Chat Application

scripts.dev: node init && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.dev:server: node init && npm --prefix server run dev
scripts.dev:client: node init && npm --prefix client run dev
scripts.build: node init && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.vercel-build: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.start: node init && npm --prefix server run start
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
